new_destinations.name: Doubtless Bay
new_destinations.reason: Five kept places (Mangōnui, Tokerau Beach, Rangikapiti Pā, Coopers Beach, Maitai Bay) cluster round one base, with Wikivoyage articles for both Mangōnui and Doubtless Bay and a Top of the North tourism-board page. The 'Doubtless Bay' area candidate was rejected as a SPOT (an area made of these stops); it is proposed here as the destination that holds them. Alternative name: Mangōnui.
new_destinations.overlap_check: Numerically inside cape-reinga's current 150 km span (about 100 km from its centre) but not reached from Cape Reinga (separate base, over 1.5 h by road). No overlap once cape-reinga's span is cut to about 50 km (see existing_fixes). No overlap with bay-of-islands (over 70 km). Cable Bay stays in review.
new_destinations.fallback_if_declined: Mangōnui, Tokerau Beach, Rangikapiti Pā, Coopers Beach and Maitai Bay become standalone spots under their own ids.

new_destinations.name: Kaitaia
new_destinations.reason: Far North hub with its own Wikivoyage chapter and a tourism-board page, the base for Ninety Mile Beach and Cape Reinga tours (COVERAGE.md Granularity: a sizeable settlement with its own guidebook chapter). Kept places round it: Te Ahu Museum, Ahipara, Gumdiggers Park, Rarawa Beach. Ninety Mile Beach itself stays STANDALONE as the benchmark requires. The Kaitaia candidate (photo rejected, held) is the destination itself, not a spot.
new_destinations.overlap_check: Inside cape-reinga's current 150 km span (about 93 km from its centre) but Kaitaia is its own base. No overlap once cape-reinga's span is cut to about 50 km.
new_destinations.fallback_if_declined: Te Ahu Museum, Ahipara, Gumdiggers Park and Rarawa Beach become standalone spots; Kaitaia the town becomes a standalone spot (photo still needed).

new_destinations.name: Dargaville
new_destinations.reason: Kauri Coast hub with Wikivoyage chapter-level coverage and a regional-hub role; Dargaville Museum, Baylys Beach and Kai Iwi Lakes are reached from it. The existing standalone kauri-museum (Matakohe, about 35 km south) could be re-homed here by the owner. The Dargaville candidate (photo rejected, held) is the destination itself.
new_destinations.overlap_check: Dargaville is about 45 km from the waipoua-forest centre (reach 45 km); the two spans only just touch and Waipoua's own spots lie within 12 km, so waipoua-forest could be narrowed. Waipoua and Trounson stay with waipoua-forest.
new_destinations.fallback_if_declined: Dargaville Museum, Baylys Beach and Kai Iwi Lakes become standalone spots; Dargaville the town becomes a standalone spot.

new_destinations.name: Whangaroa
new_destinations.reason: Harbour district with its own Wikivoyage article, a separate base between Kerikeri and Doubtless Bay; Matauri Bay, Taupō Bay, Tauranga Bay and Duke's Nose are reached from it. The Whangaroa candidate (a harbour village, kept) is the destination itself.
new_destinations.overlap_check: Borderline: about 42 km from the bay-of-islands centre (reach 45 km). Visitors base at Whangaroa/Kaeo, not Paihia, so it is proposed rather than folded in; Taupō Bay (about 48 km) is outside bay-of-islands' reach anyway. Owner to decide; the fallback is standalone, not bay-of-islands.
new_destinations.fallback_if_declined: Matauri Bay, Taupō Bay, Tauranga Bay and Duke's Nose become standalone spots; Whangaroa the village becomes a standalone spot.
